mechanism: The home list is linked to PersistentStorage. Loaded pages accumulate in the persistent homeList as well as the visible session list. Under the normal twelve-swipe workload, the unfixed app retains more process memory than the fixed app, which persists only its first-page snapshot. Whole-preferences file traffic includes cookies and old keys; this case does not claim a 3x reduction in file-write volume or exclusive attribution of those writes.
fix_summary: Persist only the first-page snapshot in homeListCache. Keep later loaded pages in component state. This bounds the active persisted list; it does not eliminate all preferences writes.

performance_oracle.definition: Pss of the app process after the workload, from the periodic smaps_rollup snapshots in memory/.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.3 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
performance_oracle.workload_notes: Raise PSS gate from 1.2x to 1.3x in every pair. Replace whole-file traffic attribution with actual native cache contents and successful paired UI/network progress.
